policy.ja: 各ケースの条件・採用変種・独立参照または解析解・残差・収束・失敗の扱いを確認します。共通22実行例とは別の補助配布版です。量子DFTの全走査は通常の軽量確認へ含めません。
policy.en: Check each case’s assumptions, adopted variant, independent/analytic reference, residuals, refinement and failure handling. These supplements are separate from the shared 22 execution registry. Detailed quantum-DFT sweeps are outside routine lightweight checks.

routine_policy.ja: 通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。
routine_policy.en: Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved.

intro.ja: Schnakenbergの1次元周期系で、有限振幅の過渡から成長後のパターンまでをたどります。別の数値解法で得た参照に照合し、格子・時間刻み・参照自身の誤差を分けて調べます。
intro.en: Follow a 1D periodic Schnakenberg system from finite-amplitude transients to post-growth patterns. Compare with a separate numerical reference and distinguish grid, time-step and reference errors.

title.ja: 多峰性MCMC：混合不良と収束診断の独立検証
title.en: Multimodal MCMC: independent checks of poor mixing and convergence diagnostics

intro.ja: 二峰性分布で、局所的な閉じ込めと峰間の移動を比べます。自己相関・有効標本数・収束診断の計算を独立実装と照合し、診断値だけでは見逃す探索不足も示します。
intro.en: Compare local trapping and between-mode movement on a bimodal target. Check autocorrelation, effective sample size and convergence diagnostics against an independent implementation, and expose missed exploration that diagnostics alone cannot detect.

title.ja: CTとGLM：同条件の独立照合・格子・時間収束
title.en: CT and GLM: matched controls, independent checks and grid/time convergence

intro.ja: 数値流束族・LLF係数・時間刻み・物理減衰率を固定し、CTとGLMの離散化を比較します。構成した滑らかな厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使い、格子誤差・時間積分誤差・参照自身の差を分けて確かめます。
intro.en: Compare CT and GLM discretizations with a matched flux family, LLF coefficient, time steps and fixed physical damping. Use a constructed smooth exact solution and independent Athena++ results to separate spatial, time-integration and reference differences.

title.ja: 基盤手法：条件数・残差・収束と独立参照
title.en: Numerical foundations: conditioning, residuals, convergence and independent references

intro.ja: AMG、QR／SVD、Krylov固有値解法、求積を固定した条件系列で比較します。残差と前進誤差、行列と積分の条件の違いを測り、独立参照との一致だけでなく、収束の限界や診断の見落としも確かめます。
intro.en: Compare AMG, QR/SVD, Krylov eigenvalue methods and quadrature across fixed conditioning families. Separate residuals from forward error and matrix from integral conditioning; check independent references alongside convergence limits and diagnostic blind spots.

title.ja: 粒子・輸送：独立参照・保存則・統計誤差
title.en: Particles and transport: independent references, conservation and statistical error

intro.ja: 周期力、FMM、PIC、衝突、放射輸送の既存問題を別版で検証します。決定論的な離散誤差、保存則、有限粒子数の偏りと統計誤差を分けます。
intro.en: Extend existing periodic-force, FMM, PIC, collision and radiation problems in a separate release. Separate deterministic discretization, conservation, finite-particle bias and statistical error.

intro.en: Compare short-time nonlinear Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion with the same initial field, grid, subsolvers and observation times. This lightweight addition checks temporal convergence and numerical-reference sensitivity while retaining existing spatial and long-time pattern records.

title.ja: Noh衝撃波：厳密解・過熱誤差・格子収束
title.en: Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement

intro.ja: 初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称Noh問題を1D有限体積法で解きます。厳密セル平均・原点過熱・格子収束を比較し、球では離散保存と境界時間求積の誤差を別々に検証します。
intro.en: Solve zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical Noh flow with 1D finite volumes. Compare exact cell means, origin heating and refinement; separately verify discrete budgets and boundary-time-quadrature error in spherical flow.

title.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける
title.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error

summary.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
summary.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の単位正方形、一定正係数の−Δu=f、全周同次Dirichlet境界、5点差分です。階層構築には座標・格子幅・nを渡さず、係数行列と暗黙の定数近似核だけを使います。入力は実対称正定値を前提とし、任意の不定値行列を扱うソルバーではありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unit square, constant-positive-coefficient −Δu=f, homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries and five-point differences. Hierarchy setup receives no coordinates, mesh width or n; it uses the coefficient matrix and an implicit constant near-null candidate. A real SPD input is assumed; arbitrary indefinite problems are outside scope.

algorithm.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
algorithm.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

validation.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
validation.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

limits.ja: 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。
limits.en: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error.

title.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
title.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

summary.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
summary.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

assumptions.ja: m≥nの小さな実行列が対象です。SVDの数値階数は最大特異値に対する相対しきい値10⁻¹²で定義し、零特異値方向を除くcompact因子を返します。QRは列ピボットなしで、階数判定には用いません。
assumptions.en: Small real matrices with m≥n. Numerical rank uses a 10⁻¹² threshold relative to the largest singular value; compact factors omit null directions. QR has no column pivoting and is not used as a rank-revealing method.

algorithm.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
algorithm.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

validation.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
validation.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

limits.ja: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。
limits.en: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results.

title.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
title.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

summary.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
summary.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

assumptions.ja: 対称問題では実対称行列、非対称問題では既知の分離した最大固有値5を持つ実行列を使います。初期ベクトルは固定seedです。非対称Ritz値は複素数を許し、最大実部で選びます。
assumptions.en: The symmetric case is real symmetric; the nonsymmetric case is real with a known separated largest eigenvalue 5. Starting vectors use fixed seeds. Nonsymmetric Ritz values may be complex and are selected by largest real part.

algorithm.ja: Lanczosの3項漸化式に2回の全再直交化を加え、Arnoldiは修正Gram–Schmidtを2回行います。小さな射影行列T/HだけをNumPyのeigh/eigで解き、元空間へRitzベクトルを戻します。大きな元行列の密固有値計算は参照側だけで使います。
algorithm.en: Lanczos uses its three-term recurrence plus two passes of full reorthogonalization; Arnoldi uses two-pass modified Gram–Schmidt. Only the small projected T/H is solved by NumPy eigh/eig before lifting Ritz vectors. A full dense solve of the original matrix is used only on the reference side.

validation.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
validation.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

limits.ja: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。
limits.en: Unrestarted small-matrix educational examples with separated extreme eigenpairs. Interior/clustered eigenvalues, very large sparse matrices, strong nonnormality, shift-invert and implicitly restarted Arnoldi are outside scope. A small eigenpair residual alone is not treated as a rigorous eigenvalue-error bound for nonnormal matrices.

title.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
title.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

summary.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
summary.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 有限区間上の滑らかな実関数、無次元の積分です。固定Gauss次数2・4・8・16と、適応絶対公差10⁻⁵・10⁻⁷・10⁻⁹を別々に走査します。両端特異点・不連続・無限区間は今回の入力では扱いません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless smooth real functions on finite intervals. Fixed Gauss orders 2/4/8/16 and adaptive absolute tolerances 10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹ are swept separately. Endpoint singularities, discontinuities and infinite intervals are not covered by these inputs.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschで対称Jacobi行列の固有値を節点、最初の固有ベクトル成分の平方の2倍を重みとします。適応Simpsonは区間を二分し、|S左+S右−S全|/15を局所推定として公差を配分します。評価回数と深さの上限を持ち、未達を成功としません。
algorithm.en: Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly.

validation.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
validation.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

limits.ja: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。
limits.en: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK.

title.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS
title.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS

summary.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
summary.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。
assumptions.en: One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps.

algorithm.ja: log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。
algorithm.en: Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat.

validation.ja: 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。
validation.en: Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs.

limits.ja: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。
limits.en: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate.

title.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関
title.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation

summary.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。
summary.en: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations.

assumptions.ja: 質量・Boltzmann定数・角振動数・摩擦・温度は1。独立32768複製、burn時間20、刻み0.4/0.2/0.1、相関lag時間2。h*omega<2を要求します。
assumptions.en: Mass, Boltzmann constant, frequency, friction and temperature are one. Use 32768 replicas, burn time 20, steps 0.4/0.2/0.1 and correlation lag 2; require h*omega<2.

algorithm.ja: 力B・ドリフトAの半ステップと厳密OUノイズ更新OをB-A-O-A-Bで合成。サンプルの共分散・3種のCDF・エネルギー平均/分散・位置相関を記録します。
algorithm.en: Compose force B and drift A half steps with exact OU noise O in B-A-O-A-B order. Record covariance, three CDFs, energy mean/variance and position correlation.

validation.ja: SciPy離散Lyapunov解および調和系の明示共分散diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4))で照合。運動量の刻み2次偏りと有限標本誤差を分離し、burn過渡を写像で評価。連続相関は別の行列指数で算出します。
validation.en: Check against a SciPy discrete-Lyapunov solve and explicit harmonic covariance diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4)). Separate second-order momentum bias from sampling error and evaluate burn transients from the map. A separate matrix exponential gives continuous correlation.

limits.ja: 調和ポテンシャル・固定seedの分布検証です。位置分散が正確でも運動量には有限刻み偏りがあります。他のサーモスタット、一般分子系、長時間の第一原理MDへ検証を移しません。
limits.en: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD.

note.en: Check against a SciPy discrete-Lyapunov solve and explicit harmonic covariance diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4)). Separate second-order momentum bias from sampling error and evaluate burn transients from the map. A separate matrix exponential gives continuous correlation.

title.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
title.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

summary.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
summary.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

assumptions.ja: 周期区間[0,2pi)、D=0.1、r=0.1、初期cos(2x)、終了t=2。格子16/32/64と、別の固定格子で刻み0.5/0.25/0.125を用います。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi), D=0.1,r=0.1, initial cos(2x), final t=2. Use grids 16/32/64 and a separate fixed-grid timestep sequence 0.5/0.25/0.125.

algorithm.ja: 周期中心2階差分と独自RK4で進めます。空間系列は小さな同一時間刻み、時間系列は同じ空間演算子を用います。
algorithm.en: Advance original periodic second-centered differences with RK4. The spatial sequence uses one small time step; the temporal sequence fixes the spatial operator.

validation.ja: 連続固有値r-Dk²への最大誤差で空間次数、半離散固有値r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx²への最大誤差で時間次数を測ります。独立した解析参照であり同じ実装の細格子値を参照にしません。
validation.en: Measure spatial order against r-Dk² and temporal order against r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx². Both are independent analytic references, rather than a finer-grid run of the same solver.

limits.ja: 線形・周期・滑らかな単一モードだけを検証します。非線形のFisher前線、複雑境界、空間生態系や一般の反応ネットワークの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Only a linear, periodic, smooth single mode is verified. Nonlinear Fisher fronts, complex boundaries, spatial ecosystems and general reaction networks remain outside scope.

summary.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
summary.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.1,b=0.9、平衡(1,0.9)、拡散係数(0.01,1)、周期k=2、初期振幅1e-4。線形t=1と非線形t=4の短い計算に限定します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.1,b=0.9, equilibrium(1,0.9), diffusivities(0.01,1), periodic k=2 and initial amplitude1e-4. Restrict runs to linear t=1 and nonlinear t=4.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心差分・RK4で線形化PDEと短い非線形PDEを進めます。3格子でのモード振幅と成長率、非線形の濃度最小値・初期パターン増幅を記録します。
algorithm.en: Advance the linearized and short nonlinear PDEs using original centered differences/RK4. Record mode amplitudes/growth on three grids, minimum concentrations and early-pattern amplification.

validation.ja: 連続Fourier行列J-k²DのSciPy expmと線形数値解を比較し空間収束を測定。非線形計算は半離散線形行列指数との小振幅差を測り、成熟模様の参照照合とは区別します。
validation.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

limits.ja: 1つの平衡近傍の発生段階です。原著係数や原著実験の再現、成熟模様、ランダム擾乱からの波数選択、実生物の較正は主張しません。
limits.en: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

title.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
title.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

summary.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
summary.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5。I=0の休止平衡からt=10〜20だけI=0.8を与え、t=80まで進めます。生理学的な物理単位への較正はしません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5. Start at resting equilibrium for I=0, apply I=0.8 only during t=10..20 and integrate to t=80. No calibration to physiological physical units.

algorithm.ja: 独自RK4を刻み0.1/0.05/0.025で使用し、パルスの不連続点で時間区間を厳密に分割します。出力刻み0.1でピークと休止状態からの距離も測定します。
algorithm.en: Use original RK4 with steps 0.1/0.05/0.025, splitting time intervals exactly at pulse discontinuities. At output spacing 0.1, measure the peak and distance from rest.

validation.ja: 別実装SciPy DOP853のrtol1e-11と1e-13を比較して参照の感度を確認し、厳しい参照への最大解誤差と時間次数を評価します。ピーク時刻は出力格子上の精度です。
validation.en: Compare separate SciPy DOP853 at rtol=1e-11 and 1e-13 to check reference sensitivity; measure maximum solution error and time order against the tighter reference. Peak time is resolved only on the output grid.

limits.ja: FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
limits.en: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

title.ja: 中性周期セルのEwald和と独立theta積分
title.en: Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral

summary.ja: 3次元周期Coulomb相互作用の実空間和・逆空間和・自己項を実装し、分割パラメータと打切りを変えて検証します。
summary.en: Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs.

assumptions.ja: 立方セル・全電荷ゼロ・Coulomb定数1・導体境界（tin foil）。主例は非対称な8点電荷で、NaClの8イオン配置は別の解析照合用です。
assumptions.en: Cubic cell, zero total charge, Coulomb constant one and conducting/tin-foil boundary. An asymmetric eight-charge case is distinct from the eight-ion NaCl reference cell.

algorithm.ja: erfcで減衰する実空間和、Gaussian係数を持つ構造因子の逆格子和、−alpha/sqrt(pi) sum(q²)を加えます。力は各項の位置微分から求め、24成分を中心エネルギー差分と比較します。
algorithm.en: Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences.

validation.ja: 分割alphaを3点、実空間打切りを3点、逆空間打切りを4点で確認。NaClのMadelung定数は3次元和を呼ばない独立な1次元Jacobi-theta積分と照合し、求積の誤差推定も保存します。
validation.en: Three splitting parameters, three real cutoffs and four reciprocal cutoffs. Check the NaCl Madelung constant against a separately implemented 1D Jacobi-theta integral, storing its quadrature error estimate.

limits.ja: 非中性セル、背景補正、非直交セル、誘電率が有限の表面項、スラブ補正、応力、物質固有の力場は扱いません。
limits.en: No charged-cell/background correction, triclinic cell, finite-dielectric surface term, slab correction, stress or material-specific force field.

title.ja: Bスプラインsmooth PMEの格子・次数収束

summary.ja: 電荷をBスプラインで格子へ割り当て、FFTでEwald逆空間項を評価するsmooth PME（SPME）の小規模例です。
summary.en: A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT.

assumptions.ja: Ewaldと同じ中性立方セルと実空間項を使います。PME族のうちEssmannらのBスプライン変種を採用し、Dardenらの原法のLagrange補間とは区別します。
assumptions.en: The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。
algorithm.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

validation.ja: 16³・24³・40³格子と2つの次数で、直接Ewald逆空間和との差を記録します。Ewaldと実空間項・自己項を共有する部分も明示。最細格子の力はエネルギー差分とも比較し、全電荷の保持を確認します。
validation.en: Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge.

limits.ja: 有限格子のaliasingにより、エネルギー勾配型の合力は厳密にはゼロでなく、その診断量を保存します。運動量保存・長時間MD・原法PME・最適化P³M・スラブ補正の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed.

title.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM
title.en: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L

summary.ja: 自由空間の対数ポテンシャルを一様四分木の多重極・局所展開で評価し、直接和と比較します。
summary.en: Evaluate a free-space log potential with uniform-quadtree multipole and local expansions and compare with direct sums.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形内の有限点電荷ですが、境界は壁でなく木を作る包囲領域です。核はphi=−sum(q log r)、電場は−grad(phi)。自己項を除外し、周期像はありません。
assumptions.en: Particles lie in a unit-square bounding box, not a physical wall boundary. The kernel is phi=−sum(q log r), with field −grad(phi); self terms are excluded and no periodic images are used.

algorithm.ja: 葉でP2M、上向きのM2M、相互作用リスト上のM2L、下向きのL2L、局所多項式の評価と近接P2Pを実装します。遠方を粒子ごとに開くBarnes–Hutへ置き換えず、移動演算回数と近接対数を記録します。
algorithm.en: Implement leaf P2M, upward M2M, interaction-list M2L, downward L2L, local-polynomial evaluation and near-field P2P. Record translation and near-pair counts; this is not a Barnes–Hut traversal relabeled as FMM.

validation.ja: 固定seedの128粒子で次数2・4・8・12を走査し、別の全対直接和とポテンシャル・電場の全成分を照合します。2点の符号、順序不変性、ポテンシャル微分も検査します。
validation.en: For 128 fixed-seed particles, sweep orders 2/4/8/12 and compare every potential/field component with a separate all-pairs calculation. Also check two-source signs, permutation invariance and potential derivatives.

limits.ja: 3次元1/r核、適応木、周期FMM、特異積分、実測の計算量スケーリングは未検証です。2次元自由空間の教育用実装として表示します。
limits.en: No 3D 1/r kernel, adaptive tree, periodic FMM, singular quadrature or empirical complexity/scaling study. Evidence applies to this 2D free-space educational implementation.

title.ja: CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動
title.en: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC

summary.ja: 1次元周期セルの電子をCICで格子と結び、Poisson方程式と粒子運動を自洽に進めます。
summary.en: Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently.

assumptions.ja: 長さ2pi、電子の電荷質量比−1、静止イオン背景密度1、plasma frequency=1の無次元系。quiet startから振幅0.001の微小正弦変位を与えます。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless length 2pi, electron charge/mass −1, stationary ion density one and plasma frequency one. A quiet start receives a small sinusoidal displacement of amplitude 0.001.

algorithm.ja: CIC電荷割当てと同じ重みの場補間、ゼロ平均のスペクトルPoisson解、速度Verletを組み合わせます。実数の奇微分の規約により、電場のNyquistモードはゼロにします。
algorithm.en: Combine CIC deposition and matching field gathering, a mean-zero spectral Poisson solve and velocity Verlet. Set the field Nyquist mode to zero for a real skew-adjoint spectral derivative.

validation.ja: 32・64・128格子の系列と、別の512格子上の時間刻み系列を分けます。変位モードを連続線形理論のcos(t)と比較し、全電荷・Poissonポテンシャル残差・単一粒子の自己力を検査します。
validation.en: Separate a 32/64/128-grid sweep from timestep refinement on a 512 grid. Compare displacement amplitude with continuum linear cos(t), and check charge compatibility, potential-Poisson residual and single-particle self force.

limits.ja: 有限振幅・有限粒子数の誤差床があります。非線形不安定性、Landau減衰、衝突、電磁PIC、相対論粒子、境界流入出の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite amplitude and finite particles leave an error floor. Nonlinear instabilities, Landau damping, collisions, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and open particle boundaries are unvalidated.

title.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component

summary.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子のランダム二体衝突で、保存則と平衡分布への緩和を検証します。
summary.en: Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules.

assumptions.ja: 等質・等質量・等方散乱・一定衝突率。各roundで全粒子を一度ずつランダムに組み合わせます。初期は±sqrt(3)の二つのビームで、温度の目標は1です。 各seedは総運動量0・総エネルギー固定のmicrocanonical系で、Maxwell/Gammaは大粒子数極限の参照です。
assumptions.en: Homogeneous, equal masses, isotropic scattering and constant collision rate. Each round randomly matches every particle once. Two initial beams at ±sqrt(3) give target temperature one. Each seed has zero total momentum and fixed total energy: its finite-N equilibrium is microcanonical, while Maxwell/Gamma are large-N references.

algorithm.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
algorithm.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

validation.ja: 粒子512・2048・8192、16 seedで、運動量・運動エネルギー、Maxwellの2次/4次モーメント、Gamma(3/2,1)のエネルギーCDFを比較。異方性の期待減衰率(N−2)/(2(N−1))も独立に照合します。 有限Nの成分4次モーメントは3−6/(3N−1)であり、Maxwell値3との有限N偏りとseed間の標本誤差を区別します。
validation.en: Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty.

limits.ja: DSMCの衝突部分の教育例です。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存の衝突選択、実際の輸送係数・流れ場・全seedでの保証は含みません。Bird原著の剛体球条件を再現したとは主張しません。
limits.en: This is an educational DSMC collision component. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection, measured transport coefficients/flow fields or every-seed guarantee. Bird’s original hard-sphere conditions are not reproduced.

title.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標放射輸送
title.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab

summary.ja: 純吸収の定常放射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。
summary.en: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux.

assumptions.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の一様平板。正の半球から単位強度が入射し、逆向きの入射・散乱・内部放射はゼロです。
assumptions.en: A uniform slab of optical depth 0.7 receives unit intensity over the positive hemisphere, with zero reverse inflow, scattering and emission.

algorithm.ja: 正のGauss–Legendre離散方向と1次風上有限体積の空間行進を使います。角度誤差だけを分ける系列では、一定セル内を指数関数で正確に伝播します。
algorithm.en: Use positive Gauss–Legendre ordinates and first-order upstream finite-volume marching. A separate angular-error sweep uses exact exponential propagation within each constant cell.

validation.ja: 32〜512セルで全方向の強度誤差・空間フラックス誤差・正値性・離散吸収収支を確認。4〜32方向の別系列は、出射フラックス2pi E3(tau)の解析表示と比較します。
validation.en: With 32–512 cells, check all ray intensities, spatial flux error, positivity and discrete absorption balance. A separate 4–32-ordinate sweep compares exit flux with the analytic 2pi E3(tau) representation.

limits.ja: 多重散乱、熱放射、周波数再分配、動的媒質、放射流体連成は未実装です。StamnesらのDISORTの全機能・安定化を再現したとは表示しません。
limits.en: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization.

title.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較
title.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++

summary.ja: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。
summary.en: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、vz=Bz=0、t=0.05。rho=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(-sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(-sin2πy,sin4πx)/sqrt(4π)。
assumptions.en: Unit square, gamma=5/3, mu0=1, vz=Bz=0, t=0.05. rho=25/(36pi), p=5/(12pi), v=(-sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(-sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi).

algorithm.ja: 公開済みの1次Rusanov/前進Eulerを再利用。CTは共有corner EMFの離散curl、GLMはcell中心Bと双曲・放物型cleaning。Athena++は別実装のHLLD+PLM+RK2。
algorithm.en: Reuse the published first-order Rusanov/forward-Euler solvers: shared corner-EMF discrete curl for CT and cell-centered hyperbolic/parabolic GLM cleaning. Independent Athena++ uses HLLD, PLM and RK2.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²で密度とByのL1誤差、質量・エネルギードリフト、正値性を測定。独立参照は128²/256²でも収束を確認し、細胞平均を保存的に制限します。
validation.en: Measure density/By L1 error, mass/energy drift and positivity on 16²/32²/64². Check the independent 128²/256² reference and conservatively restrict its fine-cell averages.

limits.ja: CTの面上divergenceとGLMの中心差分divergenceは異なる演算子です。共通cell演算子の値も別記します。Athenaの初期磁場はベクトルポテンシャルの差分による面平均で、同じ連続場の離散化差を含みます。短時間の平面MHD比較であり、衝撃波・3D・UCTやCTUの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. This is a short planar test, not validation of shocks, 3D, UCT or CTU.

title.en: Brio–Wu against an independent HLLD implementation

summary.ja: 公開HLLD-MC有限体積コードを、固定コミットから別に構築したAthena++のBrio–Wu参照と比較します。
summary.en: Compare the published HLLD-MC finite-volume code with Brio–Wu reference data independently produced by Athena++ at a pinned commit.

assumptions.en: 1D, [0,1], t=0.1, gamma=2, Bx=0.75; left/right (rho,p,By)=(1,1,1)/(0.125,0.1,-1), zero velocity, outflow boundaries.

algorithm.ja: アトラス側はMC再構成とSSPRK2、参照は独立C++のHLLD・PLM・RK3。異なる実装ですがHLLDという数値流束の系列は共有します。
algorithm.en: Atlas uses MC reconstruction and SSPRK2; the independent C++ reference uses HLLD, PLM and RK3. Implementations differ while sharing the HLLD flux family.

validation.ja: 128/256/512セルを、2048/4096セルで再実行した独立参照の保存的細胞平均と比較。rho/ByのL1誤差、格子改善、密度・圧力正値性を判定します。
validation.en: Compare 128/256/512 cells with conservative averages of independently rerun 2048/4096-cell references. Check density/By L1 errors, refinement and positive density/pressure.

limits.ja: Brio–Wuの複合波を含む数値解との照合であり、一般MHD Riemann問題の唯一の厳密解とは呼びません。参照の再生成にはC++コンパイルが必要で、通常Python実行は同梱参照を使います。
limits.en: This compares numerical solutions including the Brio–Wu compound wave; it is not a claim of a unique exact solution for arbitrary MHD Riemann problems. Reference regeneration requires C++ compilation; routine Python runs use the stored reference.

title.ja: Shu–Osher：独立参照と格子収束
title.en: Shu–Osher: independent reference and mesh refinement

summary.ja: 衝撃波と密度正弦波の相互作用を、同じPython実装の細格子ではなく、別に実行したAthena++の参照と照合します。
summary.en: Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code.

algorithm.ja: アトラス側はMC-MUSCL/HLLC/SSPRK3、Athena++側はPLM/HLLC/RK3。公式problem generatorの位置と正弦波の波数だけを合わせるpatchを保存し、solver本体は変更しません。
algorithm.en: Atlas uses MC-MUSCL/HLLC/SSPRK3; Athena++ uses PLM/HLLC/RK3. A saved problem-generator patch matches only shock location and sinusoid wavenumber; the independent solver is unchanged.

validation.ja: 100/200/400セルの密度L1誤差と改善率、正値性を測り、参照2048/4096/8192セルの差も事前幅と比較します。境界へ衝撃波が届かない固定時刻で比較します。
validation.en: Measure density L1 error, refinement and positivity on 100/200/400 cells; also compare 2048/4096/8192 reference differences with a predeclared bound. The shock has not reached the boundaries at the fixed comparison time.

limits.ja: 参照は厳密解ではなく独立した有限格子数値解です。異なる流束系列すべての優劣、WENOの一般的高次数、負圧防止の保証には広げません。 参照2048→4096のL1差0.005346は事前幅0.005を満たさず、8192へ細分しました。途中の未達記録も残します。
limits.en: The reference is an independent finite-grid numerical solution, not an exact solution. No universal flux ranking, WENO-order claim or positivity guarantee is inferred. The 2048-to-4096 reference L1 increment0.005346 missed the predeclared0.005 bound, so8192 cells were added. The earlier miss remains recorded.

title.ja: GLMの磁気単極子モード：解析的減衰
title.en: GLM longitudinal mode: analytic damping

summary.ja: GLM cleaning単独の縦磁場Fourierモードを、連続線形方程式の行列指数解と比較します。
summary.en: Compare a longitudinal magnetic Fourier mode of GLM cleaning with the continuous linear matrix-exponential solution.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,1]、Bx=cos2πx、psi=0、ch=1、減衰κ=2、t=1。流体との結合を外した線形診断です。

algorithm.ja: ∂tBx=-∂xpsi、∂tpsi=-ch²∂xBx-κpsiを中心差分とRK4で積分。独立参照は連続Fourier記号の2×2行列指数です。
algorithm.en: Integrate Bx_t=-psi_x and psi_t=-ch² Bx_x-kappa psi with centered differences/RK4. The independent reference exponentiates the continuous 2x2 Fourier symbol.

validation.ja: 16/32/64点でL2誤差、空間2次収束、磁場divergenceモード振幅の減衰を判定します。
validation.en: Check L2 error, second-order spatial refinement and damping of the divergence-mode amplitude at 16/32/64 points.

limits.ja: この線形モードの減衰を、非線形MHDの全divergenceや大域的な精度の保証とはしません。CTで表せない単極子モードをCTとの同条件比較には用いません。
limits.en: Linear-mode damping does not guarantee divergence control or global accuracy for every nonlinear MHD problem. A monopole mode that CT cannot represent is not used as a matched CT comparison.

title.ja: CSVRの厳密浴：条件付き分布・揺らぎ・運動エネルギー相関
title.en: Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation

summary.ja: 自由度1・2・6のCSVR浴だけを実装し、厳密な条件付きモーメントと非心χ²分布、正準Gamma分布と運動エネルギー相関を照合します。
summary.en: Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations.

assumptions.ja: kB=1、T=1.3、τ=0.5、h=0.2、65536独立複製。3初期Kと3自由度で条件付き分布を測定。Hamiltonianの力・座標・拘束・COM除去は含みません。
assumptions.en: kB=1, T=1.3, tau=0.5, h=0.2, 65536 independent replicas. Test three initial energies at each of three degree counts. No Hamiltonian force, positions, constraints or center-of-mass removal.

algorithm.ja: 平方完成した厳密CIR遷移を、標準正規Rと独立χ²(Nf−1)のSから作ります。同じRでglobal αの符号を決め、Nf=1ではS=0。単位方向と新しい半径からpを再構成し、極小KでKnew/Kを作りません。K=0は方向が未定義として拒否します。
algorithm.en: Use the completed-square exact CIR transition with normal R and independent chi-square(Nf−1) S. The same R sets the sign of global alpha; S=0 for Nf=1. Reconstruct momentum from its unit direction and new radius without a tiny-K energy ratio. Reject K=0 because its direction is undefined.

validation.ja: 条件付き平均・分散は独立なCIR式、CDFの3確率点はSciPyの非心χ²分位点、定常KはGamma分布、浴単独ACFはexp(−t/τ)と照合。無雑音の平均緩和は分散を失う対照として別表示します。
validation.en: Compare with separate CIR conditional moments, three SciPy noncentral-chi-square quantile probabilities, stationary Gamma K and bath-only exp(−t/tau) correlation. A separate noiseless mean-relaxation control demonstrates loss of fluctuations.

limits.ja: 浴の診断用ケースで独立した物理問題数へ加算しません。浴がKを正しく分布させてもglobal rescalingだけでは方向を熱化しません。exp(−t/τ)を力付きMDのK相関へ流用しません。固定seedと予算に対する統計判定で、一般の混合保証ではありません。
limits.en: A bath diagnostic, not another independent physical problem. Correct K sampling does not thermalize momentum directions by global scaling alone. The bath-only exp(−t/tau) identity is not a full-MD kinetic ACF. Statistical decisions apply to fixed seeds/budgets, not general mixing guarantees.

formulas: \bar K=\frac{N_fT}{2},\quad c=e^{-h/\tau},\quad A=\frac{T(1-c)}2,\quad R\sim N(0,1),\ S\sim\chi^2_{N_f-1}

review.ja: 2007年原著の著者稿arXiv:0803.4060v1（2008年掲示）のII.1–II.3、Appendix Aの厳密運動エネルギー更新を確認。SISSAの出版社PDFは取得できず、原著の分子系を再現したものではありません。χ²は直接生成し、著者が後に指摘したΓ生成手順のtypoを写しません。
review.en: Checked theory II.1–II.3 and the exact kinetic-energy propagator in Appendix A of the author manuscript arXiv:0803.4060v1 (posted 2008 for the 2007 article). The SISSA publisher PDF was unavailable. Original molecular applications are not reproduced. Direct chi-square sampling avoids copying the gamma-generation typo later noted by the author.

title.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
title.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

summary.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
summary.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 両方式とも厳密な浴O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2)（OBABO）。CSVRは全運動量に同じ係数、Langevinは各成分に独立OU雑音を作用。γ=1/(2τ)で自由浴のK緩和時間をそろえます。以前のBAOAB例は変更せず別の分割として残します。
algorithm.en: Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting.

validation.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
validation.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

limits.ja: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。
limits.en: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD.

scope.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。
scope.en: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations.

name.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
name.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

scope.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
scope.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

caption.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関：この実行例の保存済み検証図。
caption.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: saved validation figure for this execution.

note.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
note.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

title.ja: 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較
title.en: Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature

summary.ja: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
summary.en: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), lambda=0.2, U=sum(omega²q²/2+lambda q⁴/4). Use 8192 canonical and 4096 heated replicas, t=20, tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05, lags 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 同じOBABO分割でglobal CSVRとlocal OUを比較。正準初期座標はGaussianを包絡にした独立棄却法、運動量はMaxwell分布から生成し、別の温度摂動初期集団も進めます。
algorithm.en: Compare global CSVR and local OU with the same OBABO splitting. Draw initial canonical positions by independent Gaussian-envelope rejection and momenta from Maxwell distributions, and evolve a separate heated initial ensemble.

validation.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
validation.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

limits.ja: 特定の分離可能な四次2自由度・固定seedだけの小さな例です。Hを調和系のGamma分布と扱いません。全系相関には独立な厳密動力学参照がなく、相関一致や統計誤差に隠れる時間次数を合格主張しません。成熟分子系・輸送係数・量子・第一原理MDの検証ではありません。
limits.en: A small example for one separable two-mode quartic potential and fixed seeds. H is not treated as harmonic Gamma. No independent exact full-system dynamical reference is claimed, and neither matching correlations nor time order hidden by sampling noise is an acceptance claim. Molecular transport, quantum and ab initio MD are outside scope.

review.ja: 2007年原著の著者稿arXiv:0803.4060v1（2008年掲示）のII.1–II.3、Appendix Aの厳密運動エネルギー更新を確認。SISSAの出版社PDFは取得できず、原著の分子系を再現したものではありません。χ²は直接生成し、著者が後に指摘したΓ生成手順のtypoを写しません。
review.en: Checked theory II.1–II.3 and the exact kinetic-energy propagator in Appendix A of the author manuscript arXiv:0803.4060v1 (posted 2008 for the 2007 article). The SISSA publisher PDF was unavailable. Original molecular applications are not reproduced. Direct chi-square sampling avoids copying the gamma-generation typo later noted by the author.

review.ja: 著者稿のI・II節、式(8)の有限刻み更新、式(9)のα符号、同じGaussianの使用、Nf=1のLangevin同値、τ=1/(2γ)を確認。原著Lennard-Jonesの長時間輸送係数は再現していません。
review.en: Checked sections I–II, finite-step update Eq. (8), the sign of alpha in Eq. (9) using the same Gaussian, the Nf=1 Langevin limit and tau=1/(2 gamma). The original long Lennard-Jones transport calculations are not reproduced.

review.ja: 著者の公式アルゴリズム頁にある2007年論文のGaussian二乗和をΓ分布で生成する記述のtypo注記を確認。年は確認年。配布コードの転載ではなく独自実装です。
review.en: Checked the author’s official note identifying a typo in the 2007 paper’s gamma-based generation of Gaussian-square sums. Year is access year. This is an original implementation, not a reproduction of the downloadable code.

comparison_policy.correlation_policy: Measure q,p,K,H separately. Global and local full-MD correlations need not agree.
comparison_policy.heated_start: Finite-time full-support ensemble check, not a general mixing proof.

Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

assumptions.ja: 1D周期x∈[0,2π)、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。共通初期値u=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x。反射対称かつπ周期の不変部分空間で、原点を固定します。
assumptions.en: 1D periodic x∈[0,2π), a=.1,b=.9,D=(.01,1). Common IC u=1+.08cos(2x)+.01cos(4x), v=.9−.03cos(2x)−.002cos(4x), restricted to a reflection-even, pi-periodic invariant subspace with a fixed origin.

algorithm.ja: 二次中心FD行列の固有値−4sin²(πk/N)/Δx²をFFTで対角化して拡散を厳密に半刻み進め、反応を各点2×2 Newtonのimplicit midpointで全刻み進めるStrang合成。FFT使用時も空間離散はFDです。未収束・予算超過は失敗とし、濃度のclippingはしません。
algorithm.en: Strang-compose exact half-step diffusion of the FD matrix, diagonalized by FFT with symbol −4sin²(πk/N)/dx², and a full implicit-midpoint reaction step solved by local2×2 Newton iterations. FFT does not change FD space into spectral space. Fail on nonconvergence/budget excess; never clip concentrations.

validation.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
validation.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

limits.ja: 選択対称性を持つ1D教育用モデルで、乱数からの自由な波数選択・位相安定性・2D斑点・実生物の較正を検証しません。原著の係数や実験の再現ではありません。陰的midpointはA安定でもL安定・無条件正値ではなく、反応でu+vは保存しません。初回粗刻みは不合格で、受入基準を変えず時間解像度を強化した履歴を保持。量子計算は追加しません。
limits.en: A selected-symmetry1D educational model: no test of free noise-driven wavenumber selection, phase stability,2D spots or biological calibration. Not an original-paper reproduction. Implicit midpoint is A-stable but not L-stable or unconditionally positive; reactions do not conserve u+v. The initial coarse protocol failed; temporal resolution was strengthened while retaining every acceptance threshold and the failed record. No quantum calculations.

summary.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

reference.method: real cosine Fourier-Galerkin / SciPy Radau, analytic Jacobian
reference.scope: Reflection-even, pi-periodic IC; fixed-origin raw-field comparison; no phase alignment.

editorial_note.ja: 空間比較は別のFourier–Galerkin/Radau参照に、時間比較は同じ差分半離散系を別に解くRadau参照に照合します。後者を連続PDEの厳密解とは呼びません。最初の粗い時間刻みでは分割誤差が空間誤差を覆ったため、判定基準を維持して刻みを細かくしました。旧入力と失敗指標も配布版に残します。
editorial_note.en: Space refinement uses a separate Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference; time refinement uses an independently integrated Radau solution of the same FD semidiscrete system, not an exact continuous-PDE solution. Splitting error masked spatial error in the first coarse-step pilot. Steps were refined while keeping the acceptance criteria; the original input and failed metrics remain in the release.

assumptions.ja: 1D周期x∈[0,2π)、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。共通初期値u=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x。反射対称かつπ周期の不変部分空間で、原点を固定します。
assumptions.en: 1D periodic x∈[0,2π), a=.1,b=.9,D=(.01,1). Common IC u=1+.08cos(2x)+.01cos(4x), v=.9−.03cos(2x)−.002cos(4x), restricted to a reflection-even, pi-periodic invariant subspace with a fixed origin.

algorithm.ja: 二次中心FD行列の固有値−4sin²(πk/N)/Δx²をFFTで対角化して拡散を厳密に半刻み進め、反応を各点2×2 Newtonのimplicit midpointで全刻み進めるStrang合成。FFT使用時も空間離散はFDです。未収束・予算超過は失敗とし、濃度のclippingはしません。
algorithm.en: Strang-compose exact half-step diffusion of the FD matrix, diagonalized by FFT with symbol −4sin²(πk/N)/dx², and a full implicit-midpoint reaction step solved by local2×2 Newton iterations. FFT does not change FD space into spectral space. Fail on nonconvergence/budget excess; never clip concentrations.

validation.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
validation.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

limits.ja: 選択対称性を持つ1D教育用モデルで、乱数からの自由な波数選択・位相安定性・2D斑点・実生物の較正を検証しません。原著の係数や実験の再現ではありません。陰的midpointはA安定でもL安定・無条件正値ではなく、反応でu+vは保存しません。初回粗刻みは不合格で、受入基準を変えず時間解像度を強化した履歴を保持。量子計算は追加しません。 近飽和は参照の90→100の検査窓に対する判定で、厳密定常解・非線形安定性・長期吸引の証明ではありません。lateの巨大な線形差は線形化の破綻診断で、精度誤差ではありません。
limits.en: A selected-symmetry1D educational model: no test of free noise-driven wavenumber selection, phase stability,2D spots or biological calibration. Not an original-paper reproduction. Implicit midpoint is A-stable but not L-stable or unconditionally positive; reactions do not conserve u+v. The initial coarse protocol failed; temporal resolution was strengthened while retaining every acceptance threshold and the failed record. No quantum calculations. Near-saturation refers to the reference90→100 test window; it proves no exact steady state, nonlinear stability or long-term attractor. A huge late linearized difference diagnoses failure of linearization, not numerical error.

review.en: Checked official PubMed bibliography/DOI and publisher-indexed abstract. Full text returned403. Historical source for the reaction family, not a claim to reproduce original coefficients or experiments.

review.en: Checked official Radau IIA order5, local rtol/atol scaling, analytic Jacobians and termination status. ODE tolerances do not certify global continuum-PDE accuracy.

summary.ja: t=100の1D選択パターンを独立参照で照合。参照の90→100の変化・全PDE残差と、有限刻みprimaryのFD残差を分けて測ります。
summary.en: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual.

reference.method: real cosine Fourier-Galerkin / SciPy Radau, analytic Jacobian
reference.scope: Reflection-even, pi-periodic IC; fixed-origin raw-field comparison; no phase alignment.

editorial_note.ja: 近定常の判定は高精度のGalerkin参照に対する有限時間の確認です。有限刻みの分割法の固定点と、半離散PDEの定常解は一般に一致しないため、主計算のfull RHS残差を別に示します。線形化との差の大きさは非線形化の指標であり、精度や定常性の証明には使いません。選んだ反射対称・π周期の部分空間での確認です。
editorial_note.en: Near-stationarity is a finite-time check of the high-accuracy Galerkin reference. A finite-step splitting fixed point need not solve the semidiscrete PDE’s steady equations, so the primary full-RHS residual is reported separately. A large difference from linearization indicates nonlinearity, not accuracy or stationarity. The selected reflection-even, pi-periodic subspace is the scope of the test.

Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained.

limits.ja: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。
limits.en: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations.

references.author: A. Vehtari, A. Gelman, D. Simpson, B. Carpenter and P.-C. Bürkner
references.title: Rank-Normalization, Folding, and Localization: An Improved R-hat for Assessing Convergence of MCMC (with Discussion)

review.ja: 訂正済み著者公開PDFの第3–4節、式4.1の分母S+1/4への2021-06-22訂正、定数indicatorの注意を確認。原著の全数値実験を再現したものではありません。
review.en: Checked original sections3–4, the2021-06-22 correction of Eq4.1 to denominator S+1/4, and the constant-indicator warning. This does not reproduce every original numerical experiment.

references.author: C. J. Geyer
references.title: Practical Markov Chain Monte Carlo

review.ja: 原著第3.3節・定理3.1/3.2で可逆性等の条件とinitial-positive/monotone列を確認。本論文473–483頁と合本の討論頁を区別。有限鎖から真のESSが厳密に分かる保証とは扱いません。
review.en: Checked section3.3 and Theorems3.1/3.2 for reversibility assumptions and initial-positive/monotone sequences. Main article pp473–483 are distinguished from combined discussion pagination; no claim gives exact true ESS from finite chains.

references.author: A. Gelman and D. B. Rubin
references.title: Inference from Iterative Simulation Using Multiple Sequences

review.ja: 原著の序論・第2節で複数鎖と分散した初期値を確認。現代のrank/folded Rhatの原典とは区別し、1992年版の全有限標本補正の再現とも呼びません。
review.en: Checked the original introduction/section2 on multiple sequences and overdispersed starts. Distinct from the later rank/folded method, and not a reproduction of every1992 finite-sample correction.

references.author: The ArviZ developers

review.ja: 公式v0.20.0のrhat/ess API、diagnostics.py/stats_utils.pyでsplit・rank・Type7 quantile・端点・定数規約を確認。commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1と導入ソースSHAを照合し、atlas診断をimportしない別環境で同じ62datasetを実計算。元コード本文は転載せず、参照値・版・hash・再生成コードを同梱します。
review.en: Checked the official0.20.0 rhat/ess API and tagged source for splitting, ranks, Type7 quantiles, endpoints and constant conventions. Installed source hashes match commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1;62 byte-identical datasets were actually processed in a separate environment without importing Atlas diagnostics. No upstream implementation is reproduced; values, versions, hashes and regeneration code are supplied.

references.title: Equation of State Calculations by Fast Computing Machines

review.ja: 出版社の書誌・抄録を確認。対称提案のMetropolis受理の原著として引用し、硬い球の原著計算を再現したとは扱いません。
review.en: Publisher bibliography and abstract checked. Cited for symmetric-proposal Metropolis acceptance; no reproduction of the original hard-sphere experiment is claimed.

references.author: W. K. Hastings
references.title: Monte Carlo sampling methods using Markov chains and their applications

review.ja: 大学で公開された原著の書誌・要約と冒頭を確認。出版社DOIの通常取得はアクセスできませんでした。今回は対称Gaussian提案なので一般の非対称提案比は実装しません。
review.en: Bibliography, summary and opening excerpt of the original paper hosted by a university checked; the publisher DOI could not be opened. This example uses symmetric Gaussian proposals and does not implement a general asymmetric proposal ratio.

title.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案
title.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal

summary.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
summary.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.

algorithm.ja: 局所幅.8、mixedのみ確率.1でy=−x+.8Z、それ以外y=x+.8Z。混合率は状態非依存でq(y|x)=q(x|y)のため対数標的比でMH判定。各鎖は独立PCG64 stream、提案の適応・棄却の間引きなし。
algorithm.en: Local scale.8; mixed uses y=−x+.8Z with probability.1, otherwise y=x+.8Z. The state-independent mixture is symmetric q(y|x)=q(x|y), so MH uses the log-target ratio. Chains use independent PCG64 streams, with no adaptation or removal of rejected states.

validation.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
validation.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

measured.scope: Scenario pass means expected behavior was detected; controls do not claim sampler convergence. Prefixes are nested, not independent repetitions.

editorial_note.ja: この検証の「合格」は、混合する系列の分布確認と、意図的に混合しない系列の失敗・診断の盲点を正しく示したことを表します。全系列が収束したという意味ではありません。RhatやESSは観測量・有限標本・初期値に依存し、同じ峰に閉じ込められた全鎖では良く見えることがあります。反射ジャンプは既知の対称性を利用する比較用の提案であり、一般の未知の多峰性を解く保証ではありません。
editorial_note.en: Passing this validation means confirming the well-mixing run and correctly exposing failures and diagnostic blind spots in deliberately trapped runs; it does not mean every run converged. Rhat and ESS depend on the observable, finite sample and initial states, and can look reassuring when all chains miss the same mode. Reflection jumps exploit known target symmetry for this comparison and do not guarantee exploration of arbitrary unknown multimodal targets.

scope.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
scope.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.

caption.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案：この実行例の保存済み検証図。
caption.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: saved validation figure for this execution.

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained.

limits.ja: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 定数observableのESS=NというArviZ raw規約を混合の証拠にしません。全同値はnull＋status、鎖ごとに異なる定数のRhatはnull＋infinite-separationとして、ライブラリの巨大finite/infを残し通常有限値の一致点から除外します。bulk ESSは原スケール平均のMCSEへ流用しません。
limits.en: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator.

references.author: A. Vehtari, A. Gelman, D. Simpson, B. Carpenter and P.-C. Bürkner
references.title: Rank-Normalization, Folding, and Localization: An Improved R-hat for Assessing Convergence of MCMC (with Discussion)

review.ja: 訂正済み著者公開PDFの第3–4節、式4.1の分母S+1/4への2021-06-22訂正、定数indicatorの注意を確認。原著の全数値実験を再現したものではありません。
review.en: Checked original sections3–4, the2021-06-22 correction of Eq4.1 to denominator S+1/4, and the constant-indicator warning. This does not reproduce every original numerical experiment.

references.author: C. J. Geyer
references.title: Practical Markov Chain Monte Carlo

review.ja: 原著第3.3節・定理3.1/3.2で可逆性等の条件とinitial-positive/monotone列を確認。本論文473–483頁と合本の討論頁を区別。有限鎖から真のESSが厳密に分かる保証とは扱いません。
review.en: Checked section3.3 and Theorems3.1/3.2 for reversibility assumptions and initial-positive/monotone sequences. Main article pp473–483 are distinguished from combined discussion pagination; no claim gives exact true ESS from finite chains.

references.author: A. Gelman and D. B. Rubin
references.title: Inference from Iterative Simulation Using Multiple Sequences

review.ja: 原著の序論・第2節で複数鎖と分散した初期値を確認。現代のrank/folded Rhatの原典とは区別し、1992年版の全有限標本補正の再現とも呼びません。
review.en: Checked the original introduction/section2 on multiple sequences and overdispersed starts. Distinct from the later rank/folded method, and not a reproduction of every1992 finite-sample correction.

references.author: The ArviZ developers
references.title: ArviZ0.20.0 public diagnostics API and tagged source

review.ja: 公式v0.20.0のrhat/ess API、diagnostics.py/stats_utils.pyでsplit・rank・Type7 quantile・端点・定数規約を確認。commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1と導入ソースSHAを照合し、atlas診断をimportしない別環境で同じ62datasetを実計算。元コード本文は転載せず、参照値・版・hash・再生成コードを同梱します。
review.en: Checked the official0.20.0 rhat/ess API and tagged source for splitting, ranks, Type7 quantiles, endpoints and constant conventions. Installed source hashes match commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1;62 byte-identical datasets were actually processed in a separate environment without importing Atlas diagnostics. No upstream implementation is reproduced; values, versions, hashes and regeneration code are supplied.

title.ja: MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件
title.en: Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies

summary.ja: 同一鎖の62datasetを別環境ArviZ0.20.0で実計算し、固定recipe・入力・鎖・公式ソースSHAで結びます。通常の有限値照合と、不定値のpolicy差を分けて検査します。
summary.en: Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences.

algorithm.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
algorithm.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

validation.ja: 実鎖9組×3prefix×x/indicator＋8小fixtureの62組。同じbytesを再生成して照合し、通常の有限値Rhat/ESS/ACFと、定数・鎖内ゼロ分散・odd・ties・shift・scaleを検査。別の直接lag和、定常AR(1)の無限列tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho)で有限推定の誤差も測定します。routineは保存参照との照合で、ArviZのその場再実行は任意の別手順です。
validation.en: 62 datasets: nine actual chains times three prefixes times x/indicator plus eight small fixtures. Regenerate and hash identical bytes; compare ordinary finite Rhat/ESS/ACF and test constants, zero within-chain variance, odd lengths, ties, shift and scale. Direct lag sums and infinite-series stationary-AR(1) tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho) provide separate checks of finite estimates. Routine runs compare stored references; live ArviZ regeneration is a separate optional procedure.

editorial_note.ja: 独立ライブラリとの一致は診断値の計算の照合であり、目標分布を十分探索した証明ではありません。定数や峰指示関数の変動不足は数値のESSへ置き換えず、状態と理由を併記します。負の自己相関ではESSが標本数を超える場合があり、旧Gaussian例の保守的な下限規約とは区別します。
editorial_note.en: Agreement with an independent library checks diagnostic computation; it does not prove adequate target exploration. Constants and insufficiently varying mode indicators carry explicit states and reasons rather than a reassuring numeric ESS. Negative autocorrelation can yield ESS above the draw count; this is distinct from the conservative floor used in the earlier Gaussian example.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。

title.ja: CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束
title.en: CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium

summary.ja: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。
summary.en: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

assumptions.ja: 周期単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、平面MHD。A=.05[cos2π(x−.3t)+cos2π(y−.2t)]、B=(Ay,−Ax)、ρ=1、v=(.3,.2)、p=.1+(2π)²A²/2、t=.1。保存変数の解析的セル平均を比較します。公刊の標準問題名を借りない構成検証例です。
assumptions.en: Periodic unit square, gamma5/3, mu0=1, planar MHD. A=.05[cos2pi(x−.3t)+cos2pi(y−.2t)], B=(Ay,−Ax), rho1, v=(.3,.2), p=.1+(2pi)²A²/2 at t=.1. Compare analytic conserved cell averages. This is a constructed verification case, not a claimed published standard benchmark.

algorithm.ja: 両法とも区分定数・同じ固定Rusanov速度α=3・前進Eulerです。CTは面Bと共有算術corner EMF、GLMはcell B/ψとch=3・物理減衰率κ=2を使用。全格子で同じ384刻み、両法のdt列も同一です。CT面平均から復元した初期cell BとGLM初期Bが一致します。
algorithm.en: Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B.

validation.ja: 16²/32²/64²の保存変数L1/L2/L∞誤差と観測次数を測ります。最細格子の刻み倍増差を空間誤差の.1以下と比較。時間収束は固定8²で16/32/64/128刻みを、許容誤差・最大刻みを二重に細分したDOP853へ照合します。質量・E、正値性、native CT divと共通cell div、ψも記録します。
validation.en: Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi.

limits.ja: 定数LLF粘性・周期中心演算子では、GLMのdiv=ψ=0部分空間は丸めまで保たれます。本例は結合MHDの精度を調べ、能動的cleaningは別の非物理診断対照で調べます。p(q平均)はpの厳密平均と同一ではありません。DOP853は時間だけ独立で空間RHSは共有します。刻み倍増差は経験的汚染目安で厳密誤差上界ではなく、CT/GLMの内部表現差を含む有限離散化全体の比較です。
limits.en: With constant LLF viscosity and periodic centered operators, the GLM div=psi=0 subspace remains invariant up to roundoff. This tests coupled-MHD accuracy; a separate nonphysical control activates cleaning. p(q-average) is not the exact averaged p. DOP853 is independent in time only and shares the spatial RHS. Step differences are empirical contamination indicators, not rigorous bounds; face/cell representation differences remain part of the comparison.

review.ja: 通常のGLMのB/ψ式と減衰、エネルギー保存、追加のEGLM項との区別を原著の選択式で確認しました。全文監査ではありません。
review.en: Checked selected original GLM B/psi and damping equations, conserved physical energy, and the distinction from extra EGLM source terms; not a full-paper audit.

references.author: T. A. Gardiner and J. M. Stone

review.ja: 面平均Bと共有corner EMFの構造を確認しました。今回の算術flux-CTを、論文のupwind CT・CTU実装そのものとは呼びません。
review.en: Checked the face-average/shared-corner-EMF structure. The present arithmetic flux-CT is not identified with the paper’s upwind CT/CTU algorithm.

review.en: Confirmed the original comparison topic and bibliographic identity; not a source of this experiment’s criteria or constructed equilibrium.

review.ja: DOP853を別の時間積分器として実行します。空間RHSを共有するため、独立した空間離散化とは呼びません。
review.en: Execute DOP853 as a separate time integrator; shared spatial RHS means it is not an independent spatial discretization.

equations: A=a[\cos k(x-ut)+\cos k(y-vt)],\quad\mathbf B=(A_y,-A_x),\quad J_z=-\Delta A=k^2A
\bar{\mathbf U}_{ij}=\frac1{\Delta x\Delta y}\int_{K_{ij}}\mathbf U\,dx\,dy,\qquad p(\bar{\mathbf U})\ne\bar p
\mathbf U^{m+1}=\mathbf U^m+\Delta t\,L_h(\mathbf U^m),\qquad C_{\rm sum}=\alpha\Delta t(\Delta x^{-1}+\Delta y^{-1})

editorial_note.ja: この滑らかな移流平衡はアトラスで構成した厳密解です。保存量のセル平均を比較し、そのセル平均から回復する圧力と圧力自体の厳密なセル平均を区別します。同じ半離散空間演算子に別の時間積分を適用した参照は、時間誤差の照合であり独立PDEソルバーとは呼びません。
editorial_note.en: This translating smooth equilibrium is an exact solution constructed for the Atlas. Compare conserved cell averages, distinguishing pressure recovered from them from the exact cell average of pressure. A separate time integrator on the same spatial semidiscretization checks time error; it is not an independent PDE solver.

assumptions.ja: 標準周期OT、γ=5/3、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(−sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(−sin2πy,sin4πx)/√(4π)、t=.05。16²/32²/64²の両法に192刻みを共用します。旧配布版を改変しない追加検証です。
assumptions.en: Standard periodic OT: gamma5/3, rho25/(36pi), p5/(12pi), v=(−sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(−sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi), t=.05. Both methods share192 steps on16²/32²/64². This supplements the previous immutable release.

algorithm.ja: 主計算は固定α=ch=3のRusanovと前進Euler、GLMκ=2は格子に依存しません。独立C++ Athena++はHLLD・PLM・RK2・upwind CTです。同じ連続初期値を用いますが、Athenaのface/primitive離散化は主計算と完全同一ではありません。
algorithm.en: Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical.

validation.ja: 密度・磁場L1誤差、格子改善、正値性、保存量とdiv/ψを測定。Athena256²/512²はともにCFL=.15、512²のCFL=.3/.15差で参照の時間感度を確認し、両増分が主計算誤差の.1以下か判定します。主計算の固定16²での時間収束を別実行DOP853へ照合し、最細格子の刻み倍増差も確認します。
validation.en: Measure density/magnetic L1 error, mesh improvement, positivity, conservation and div/psi. Athena256²/512² both useCFL.15; fixed512² CFL.3/.15 checks reference time sensitivity, with increments compared against.1 of primary error. At fixed16², compare primary time refinement with separately executed DOP853 and check finest-grid step doubling.

limits.ja: 短時間の滑らかなOTで、衝撃波後・3D・一般のcleaning性能の認証ではありません。独立Athena参照も有限格子数値解で、増分は誤差上界ではありません。旧128²/CFL.3は履歴だけで256²/CFL.15との組を純粋な格子次数に使いません。定数LLFによるGLMのdiv=ψ=0保存をcleaning成功とは呼びません。native面divと共通中心divを区別し、中心演算子のcheckerboard盲点も残します。
limits.en: Short smooth OT, not certification of post-shock,3D or general cleaning behavior. Athena is a finite-grid numerical reference; increments are not error bounds. Historical128²/CFL.3 is not paired with256²/CFL.15 to infer a pure spatial order. Constant-LLF preservation of GLM div=psi=0 is not evidence of active cleaning. Native face and common centered divergences differ; centered checkerboard blind spots remain.

title.ja: CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照
title.en: Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control

summary.ja: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。
summary.en: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem.

assumptions.ja: 32²周期格子、t=.1、128刻み、ρ=p=1、v=0、By=ψ=0。CT face Bx=.01cos[2π(i+1)/32]、GLM cell Bxはその左右face平均と同一です。CT初期native div≠0は意図的に無効な物理初期値で、CTの正しい物理計算例とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Periodic32² grid,t=.1,128 steps,rho=p=1,v=0,By=psi=0. CT faceBx=.01cos[2pi(i+1)/32]; GLM cellBx equals the adjacent-face average. The intentional nonzero native CT divergence violates valid physical CT initial data and is treated solely as a diagnostic.

algorithm.ja: 同じ完全結合MHDコードを使用。y不変・By=vy=0ではGLMのBx/ψ系が流体応答から独立するため、離散Fourier記号の2×2行列と前進Euler行列冪を別に構成します。κ=2とκ=0を同じdt・LLF粘性で比較し、Bxだけの減少を物理減衰と取り違えません。
algorithm.en: Use the same fully coupled MHD code. With y-invariance andBy=vy=0, the GLM Bx/psi subsystem decouples from fluid feedback, allowing a separately constructed2x2 discrete Fourier symbol and forward-Euler matrix power. Compare kappa2/0 at identical dt and LLF viscosity, separating B/psi phase exchange from physical damping.

validation.ja: CT native divの初期違反保持、GLMのψ励起、Bx/ψ双方の独立FE参照一致、密度・圧力正値性、物理的総E/質量保存を確認。補助波エネルギーW=〈Bx²+ψ²/ch²〉のκ2/κ0比を判定し、半離散行列指数と連続Fourier解も区別して表示します。
validation.en: Check preservation of the initial CT defect, nonzero GLM psi, independent FE agreement for bothBx/psi, positive density/pressure, and conserved physical E/mass. Test the kappa2/0 ratio of auxiliary wave energy W=mean(Bx²+psi²/ch²), separating FE, semidiscrete-exponential and continuum-Fourier references.

limits.ja: 対照の合格は「期待したCTの非除去とGLMの線形応答を正しく検出した」という意味です。非零CT divを許す物理計算を推奨しません。Wは診断用ノルムで、ψを含まない物理的総エネルギーEとは別です。GLMのBx減少には位相交換とLLF拡散も含まれ、κ0対照なしに減衰成功とは呼びません。一般非線形・境界流出・衝撃波のcleaning性能へ広げません。
limits.en: Passing means correctly detecting expected CT non-removal and the calibrated GLM response, not recommending non-solenoidal CT physical initial data. W is an auxiliary diagnostic norm, distinct from conserved physical total energy E without psi. B decay includes phase exchange and LLF diffusion; damping is assessed with the kappa0 control. No general nonlinear,boundary or shock cleaning guarantee is claimed.

title.en: AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error

summary.ja: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。
summary.en: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error.

assumptions.ja: 正方格子から作るA=T⊗I+εI⊗T、n=7/15/31、ε=1/.1/.01です。これは既知解を持つ代数系の診断であり、連続PDEの精度検証は既存Poisson例に残します。同じnではκ₂はεによらず一定です。
assumptions.en: A=T⊗I+εI⊗T with n=7/15/31 and ε=1/.1/.01. This is a known-solution algebraic diagnostic; continuum PDE validation remains in the earlier Poisson example. At fixed square n, κ₂ is independent of ε.

algorithm.ja: MITライセンスの既存アトラス教材の平滑化集約AMGを新しい独立ソースへ再利用します。階層は行列だけから構築し、強度閾値.08、Jacobi平滑化、固定相対公差10⁻¹⁰、最大180 V-cycleを使います。DSTの正弦変換による直接反転は参照側だけです。
algorithm.en: Reuse the earlier MIT-licensed Atlas educational smoothed-aggregation AMG in a separate source release. Matrix-only hierarchy setup uses strength .08, Jacobi smoothing, fixed relative tolerance 10⁻¹⁰ and at most 180 V-cycles. Sine-transform spectral inversion is reference-side only.

validation.ja: 真の残差、独立直接解との差、DSTとの差、operator complexity、全残差履歴を保存します。最大固有値方向の右辺へ最小固有値方向の摂動を加え、相対増幅κ₂を直接解で照合します。等方例は収束必須、異方性stress例は予算終了も正直に記録する事前基準です。1-cycle対照は未収束を検出します。
validation.en: Store true residual, forward error, DST agreement, operator complexity and complete histories. Perturb a maximal-eigenmode RHS in the minimal-eigenmode direction and check the predicted relative amplification κ₂ with direct solves. Isotropic runs must converge; the predeclared anisotropy stress policy permits honestly reported budget exhaustion. A one-cycle control detects nonconvergence.

limits.ja: 固定した小規模な一定係数系列のみです。任意の係数ジャンプ、非構造格子、不定値系、最適計算量・一様収束を保証しません。異方性が常にκ₂を増やす、あるいは単調に収束を悪化させるとは主張しません。
limits.en: Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence.

note.en: Reuse the earlier MIT-licensed Atlas educational smoothed-aggregation AMG in a separate source release. Matrix-only hierarchy setup uses strength .08, Jacobi smoothing, fixed relative tolerance 10⁻¹⁰ and at most 180 V-cycles. Sine-transform spectral inversion is reference-side only.
