caption.en: AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: saved validation figure for this execution.

note.ja: 真の残差、独立直接解との差、DSTとの差、operator complexity、全残差履歴を保存します。最大固有値方向の右辺へ最小固有値方向の摂動を加え、相対増幅κ₂を直接解で照合します。等方例は収束必須、異方性stress例は予算終了も正直に記録する事前基準です。1-cycle対照は未収束を検出します。
note.en: Store true residual, forward error, DST agreement, operator complexity and complete histories. Perturb a maximal-eigenmode RHS in the minimal-eigenmode direction and check the predicted relative amplification κ₂ with direct solves. Isotropic runs must converge; the predeclared anisotropy stress policy permits honestly reported budget exhaustion. A one-cycle control detects nonconvergence.

title.ja: QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数
title.en: QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank

summary.ja: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
summary.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

assumptions.ja: Hadamard直交因子U,Vとsⱼ=2⁻qj、q=0/4/8/12を使います。b=u₀とb+2⁻⁴⁰u_minを固定し、摂動増幅を測ります。q=0の重複特異値では個々の特異ベクトルは一意ではありません。
assumptions.en: Use Hadamard orthogonal factors U,V and sⱼ=2⁻qj for q=0/4/8/12. Fixed b=u₀ and b+2⁻⁴⁰u_min measure perturbation amplification. Individual singular vectors are nonunique for the repeated singular values at q=0.

algorithm.ja: Householder QR、片側Jacobi SVD、三角後退代入を実装します。SVDの数値階数閾値を10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴へ変え、同じ切捨て規約のLAPACK解と比較します。正規方程式の計算例は追加していません。
algorithm.en: Implement Householder QR, one-sided Jacobi SVD and triangular back substitution. Vary rank cutoffs 10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴ and compare with LAPACK solutions using the same truncation convention. No executed normal-equations comparison is added.

validation.ja: 再構成・直交性・特異値・右辺摂動による解差・最小二乗停留残差・厳密階数2の対照を保存します。高精度参照は実二進入力を整数比へ変換し、mpmath 1.3.0のSVDとQRを独立実行済みです。SHAと全4入力・両精度の完全性を実行時に検査し、不一致を解析解へ置換しません。
validation.en: Save reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, solution perturbations, least-squares stationarity and an exact rank-two control. The mpmath1.3.0 SVD and QR reference was actually executed using integer-ratio conversions of binary inputs. Runtime SHA and completeness guards check all four inputs at both precisions and never substitute analytic truth after a mismatch.

limits.ja: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limits.en: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

review.ja: SVDはHouseholder二重対角化とQR反復、最小二乗は別実装の高精度Householder QRです。後者は教材のQRと同じ数理的手法群であり、別の手法群とは呼びません。実際の二進浮動小数点入力を整数比で読み込み、生成専用環境で実行しました。
review.en: SVD uses Householder bidiagonalization and a QR variant; least squares uses a separate high-precision Householder QR implementation. The latter shares the educational QR mathematical family and is not called a different algorithm family. Actual binary floating-point inputs were loaded by integer ratios and executed in a generation-only environment.

editorial_note.ja: 再構成・直交性・後退誤差が小さくても、悪条件問題の前進誤差は大きくなり得ます。入力した浮動小数点行列と理想的に指定した特異値を区別し、数値階数の閾値も明記します。
editorial_note.en: Small reconstruction, orthogonality and backward errors do not ensure small forward error for an ill-conditioned problem. Distinguish the actual floating-point matrix from its intended singular values and state the numerical-rank threshold.

title.ja: Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度
title.en: Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity

summary.ja: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。
summary.en: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace.

assumptions.ja: 対称行列の上位2固有値の間隔は1/.1/.01です。非正規行列は実浮動小数点の上三角行列でK=10/1000とし、対角が既知固有値です。浮動小数点の相似変換後に名目スペクトルを厳密真値とは呼びません。
assumptions.en: Top symmetric gaps are1/.1/.01. Nonnormal matrices are actual floating-point upper-triangular inputs with K=10/1000 and known diagonal eigenvalues. Nominal spectra after floating-point similarity construction are not labelled exact truth.

algorithm.ja: 全再直交化Lanczosと2回MGSのArnoldiで縮約し、小さい射影行列だけを密に解きます。上位2ベクトルはQRで張る空間へ変換し、符号や回転に不変な射影行列差を測ります。
algorithm.en: Use fully reorthogonalized Lanczos and two-pass MGS Arnoldi; only the small projected matrix is solved densely. Compare QR-spanned top-two subspace projectors, invariant under signs and cluster rotations.

validation.ja: 解析的対角固有値とSciPy密固有値、左右固有ベクトルによる条件数を照合します。別に構成した2×2擬固有対ではK=1000で残差約2.5×10⁻⁸に対し固有値誤差.005を示します。これは反復法が出力した失敗例ではなく、残差だけでは保証できないことを示す感度対照です。
validation.en: Compare analytic triangular eigenvalues, SciPy dense eigenvalues and left/right eigenvector condition numbers. A separately constructed2×2 pseudoeigenpair has residual about2.5×10⁻⁸ but eigenvalue error.005 at K=1000. It is a sensitivity control, not a failure produced by the iterative solver.

limits.ja: NumPyの射影コアとSciPyの密参照はLAPACK基盤を共有し得るため、全面的に独立なバックエンドとはしません。解析固有値と独立構成対照を併用します。再始動、内部固有値、大規模疎行列、普遍的な単調収束は対象外です。
limits.en: NumPy projected solves and SciPy dense references may share LAPACK infrastructure and are not claimed fully independent backends. Analytic eigenvalues and constructed controls provide additional checks. Restarting, interior eigenvalues, large sparse systems and universal monotonic convergence are outside scope.

title.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
title.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

summary.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
summary.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 区間[0,1]、Gauss次数8/16/32/64/128、公差10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹です。Lorentz幅.1/.03/.01、相殺係数0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶を固定します。零積分の相対条件数は未定義としてnullで保存します。
assumptions.en: Use[0,1], Gauss orders8/16/32/64/128 and tolerances10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹. Lorentz widths are.1/.03/.01; cancellation scales are0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶. A zero integral has undefined relative condition, stored as null.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschの節点・重みと、局所差/15を用いる適応Simpsonを実装します。端点ではx=t²変換を別対照とし、狭いbumpには既知支持区間を分割した対照を用意します。これは一般的な自動救済機構ではありません。
algorithm.en: Implement Golub–Welsch nodes/weights and adaptive Simpson with a local difference/15 estimate. Companion checks use x=t² for the endpoint and a known-support split for the narrow bump; these are not general automatic rescue mechanisms.

validation.ja: roots_legendre、解析atan積分、2/3、bumpの256w/315、独立QUADPACKを比較します。QUADPACKの状態・推定誤差・評価回数・警告文も保存します。相殺はε_machine×積分絶対量に対応する絶対予算を使います。初期5点が全て零のbumpでは推定誤差0と実誤差約.00813を明示します。
validation.en: Compare roots_legendre, analytic atan integrals,2/3,the bump integral256w/315 and independent QUADPACK. Preserve QUADPACK status, estimated error, evaluation count and warning message. Cancellation uses a roundoff-aware absolute budget. When all initial five bump samples vanish, expose estimated error0 versus actual error about.00813.

limits.ja: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limits.en: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

title.ja: Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分
title.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration

summary.ja: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。
summary.en: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation.

assumptions.ja: Coulomb定数1、単位立方体の3次元周期、全電荷0、tin-foil境界。旧版と同じ非対称配置です。独立参照も同じ零モードと自己項の規約を使います。
assumptions.en: Coulomb constant one; unit cubic 3D periodic neutral cell with tin-foil boundary. The asymmetric configuration matches the earlier example; reference zero-mode and self conventions match the model.

algorithm.ja: erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。
algorithm.en: Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces.

validation.ja: 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。
validation.en: Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control.

limits.ja: 固定した中性立方セルだけです。上限感度は厳密な全配置の裾誤差保証ではありません。theta参照は別定式化の自作実装であり、第三者計算パッケージや公表された参照数表ではありません。非中性・非直交・スラブ・応力・長時間MDは対象外です。
limits.en: One fixed neutral cubic cell. Upper-limit sensitivity is not a rigorous tail bound for arbitrary configurations. The theta reference is an independently formulated original implementation, not an external package or published numerical table. Charged/triclinic/slab cells, stress and long MD are outside scope.

assumptions.ja: 同じ中性周期8電荷、alpha=5.6、実空間像3。PME族のEssmann型SPMEであり、1993年のLagrange補間の原法とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。
algorithm.en: Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation.

validation.ja: 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。
validation.en: Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control.

limits.ja: エネルギー勾配型では有限格子のaliasingにより合力は一般にゼロではありません。厳密な運動量保存や任意配置での同じ誤差、長時間MD、原法PME、SPME全変種の検証とはしません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified.

title.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ
title.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth

summary.ja: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。
summary.en: Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

assumptions.ja: 自由空間のphi=−sum(q log r)、自己項なし。単位正方形は木の包囲領域で、壁・周期境界ではありません。3次元Coulomb核とは別です。
assumptions.en: Free-space phi=−sum(q log r), excluding self terms. The unit square bounds the tree and is not a wall or periodic boundary; this is separate from a 3D Coulomb kernel.

algorithm.ja: P2M/M2M/M2L/L2Lと近接P2Pを保ち、次数2/4/8/12、深さ2/3を比較します。別のCartesian直接和、二点電荷の閉形式、正多角形の中心力と遠方ポテンシャルを参照にします。
algorithm.en: Retain P2M/M2M/M2L/L2L and near P2P; compare orders 2/4/8/12 and depths two/three. References include independent Cartesian direct sums, a closed-form charge pair and regular-polygon radial/far-field identities.

validation.ja: ポテンシャル・場の最大絶対誤差、実際の遠方移動演算、回転・平行移動誤差、電荷を掛けた力の合計を測ります。粗い展開の失敗対照も確認します。
validation.en: Measure maximum absolute potential/field errors, actual far translations, rotation/translation differences and net charge-weighted force. Detect an inaccurate low-order control.

limits.ja: 木の深さによる相互作用の分割は変わるので、一定次数で深さに対する単調収束は要求しません。対象粒子ごとの展開は厳密な作用反作用を保証せず、3次元・適応木・周期FMM・計算量スケーリングは未検証です。
limits.en: Interaction repartition changes with depth, so fixed-order depth refinement is not assumed monotone. Target-wise expansions need not preserve exact action/reaction. No 3D, adaptive/periodic FMM or complexity-scaling claim.

title.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音
title.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise

summary.ja: 冷たい1次元周期プラズマのquiet-start収束と、独立seedでの初期粒子雑音を分け、電荷・運動量・Gauss則・エネルギー誤差を保存します。
summary.en: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error.

assumptions.ja: 長さ2pi、静止イオン密度1、電子q/m=−1、plasma frequency=1、微小正弦変位0.001、最終時刻1.6。格子系列は同じ2048粒子を使い、時間系列は同じ32格子・256粒子を使います。 w=2pi/Nは粒子重み、nは格子数です。
assumptions.en: Length 2pi, stationary unit-density ions, electron q/m=−1, plasma frequency one, sinusoidal displacement 0.001 and final time 1.6. Mesh runs retain 2048 particles; time runs retain a 32-cell mesh and 256 particles. The particle weight is w=2pi/N and n is the grid count.

algorithm.ja: CIC割当て・同じ重みの場補間・スペクトルPoisson・速度Verlet。独立な時間積分法DOP853は同じ粒子格子RHSを積分し、参照自身の最大刻み感度を検査します。
algorithm.en: CIC deposition/matched gathering, spectral Poisson and velocity Verlet. The independent time algorithm DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS; compare its own maximum-step refinements.

validation.ja: 16/32/64格子とdt=.2/.1/.05を別に精密化し、線形cos(t)と時間参照の誤差を分離します。実数奇微分のNyquist零モードはGauss残差から分けて記録。時刻0の64seed・N=256/1024/4096のCICモード電力を解析期待値と比較します。
validation.en: Refine 16/32/64 grids and dt=.2/.1/.05 separately; distinguish continuum cos(t) from time-reference errors. Record the real odd derivative’s Nyquist null mode separately from Gauss residuals. Compare time-zero CIC mode power at 64 seeds and N=256/1024/4096 with its analytic expectation.

limits.ja: DOP853は独立PIC空間実装ではありません。電荷・運動量の保持とエネルギーの近似保存を区別し、初期雑音のNスケーリングを時間発展した熱プラズマの保証としません。Landau減衰・電磁PIC・相対論・衝突は未検証です。
limits.en: DOP853 is not an independent PIC spatial implementation. Distinguish charge/momentum preservation from approximate energy conservation. Initial-noise N scaling does not validate evolved warm plasmas. Landau damping, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and collisions remain unvalidated.

references.title: Computer Simulation Using Particles

review_note.en: Publisher preview bibliography, introduction and contents checked; historical source for CIC/cold plasma, not a full-book audit.

editorial_note.ja: DOP853参照は同じ粒子格子RHSを積分し、時間積分に限る独立参照です。quiet startの収束と時刻0のランダム粒子雑音を分け、エネルギーの厳密保存は主張しません。
editorial_note.en: DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS and is independent only as a time algorithm. Separate quiet-start refinement from random-load noise at time zero; do not claim exact energy conservation.

title.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差
title.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error

summary.ja: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
summary.en: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

assumptions.ja: 等質・等質量・等方散乱のMaxwell分子、N=16/64/256、独立64seed、運動量0、sum|v|²=3N。二つのビームから24round衝突させ、roundは物理時間へ換算しません。
assumptions.en: Homogeneous equal-mass isotropic Maxwell collisions; N=16/64/256, 64 independent seeds, zero momentum and sum|v|²=3N. Start with two beams and run 24 collision rounds; rounds are not calibrated physical time.

algorithm.ja: ランダムな完全対合と球面一様の散乱で、各対の運動量・エネルギーを保持します。別の標本生成ではGaussianを重心ゼロ部分空間へ射影し、半径を固定します。
algorithm.en: Uniform random complete matchings and isotropic pair scattering preserve pair momentum/energy. An independent sampler projects Gaussian vectors into the zero-center-of-mass subspace and fixes their radius.

validation.ja: 全roundの運動量・エネルギーの最大保存誤差は決定論的な許容値で検査します。最初の6roundの異方性、4点のエネルギーCDF、4次モーメントと有限NのBeta参照との差は、独立seed間の標準誤差で測ります。NによるCDF標準誤差の減少と、有限NからMaxwellへの偏りを分けます。
validation.en: Check maximum momentum/energy errors over all rounds against deterministic tolerances. Use independent-seed standard errors for six-round anisotropy, four energy-CDF points and fourth moments against the finite-N beta reference. Separate decreasing CDF sampling error with N from finite-N Maxwell bias.

limits.ja: 固定した64seedの統計的診断であり、全seedの保証ではありません。同一seed内の粒子は保存量で相関し、IIDのKS p値へ読み替えません。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存衝突選択・輸送係数は含みません。
limits.en: Statistical diagnostics cover fixed 64-seed ensembles, not every seed. Conservation correlates particles within a seed; do not use IID KS p-values. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection or transport coefficients.

title.ja: 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計
title.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

summary.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
summary.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

assumptions.ja: 定常一様平板、光学的厚さ.1/.7/3、正の半球から単位強度、逆入射・散乱・内部放射0。フラックス基準の光子入射方向はpdf=2muです。
assumptions.en: Steady uniform slab, optical depths .1/.7/3, unit incoming positive-hemisphere intensity, no reverse inflow/scattering/emission. Incoming photon directions for a flux estimator have density 2mu.

algorithm.ja: 1次風上有限体積の空間更新とGauss–Legendre方向を使い、角度系列は正確な指数伝播で空間誤差を除きます。MCはmu=sqrt(U)と指数光学距離から生存・吸収を独立に判定します。
algorithm.en: Use upstream finite volumes and Gauss-Legendre ordinates; exact exponential propagation removes spatial error in the angle series. Monte Carlo independently tracks survival/absorption using mu=sqrt(U) and exponential optical paths.

validation.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
validation.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.

limits.ja: 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱放射・放射流体連成は未検証です。
limits.en: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated.

title.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
title.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

summary.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
summary.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic.

algorithm.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
algorithm.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

validation.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
validation.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

limits.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
limits.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

title.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
title.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

summary.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
summary.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

assumptions.ja: 無次元r∈[0,1]、γ=5/3、ρ0=1、u0=-1、p0=0、T=.6。平面d=1・円筒半径対称d=2・球半径対称d=3をPDE実行し、衝撃半径は.2。外側密度は(1+t)^(d-1)、原点は反射、体積測度r^(d-1)dr。角度因子をすべての収支から共通に省き、球の解析総量はM=512/375、E=256/375です。球の図は1D半径解の中心断面で、Cartesianの2D/3D計算や角度方向の対称性破れの検証ではありません。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional r in [0,1], gamma=5/3, rho0=1, u0=-1, p0=0, T=.6. PDE runs use planar d=1, cylindrical-radial d=2 and spherical-radial d=3, with shock radius .2. Outer density is (1+t)^(d-1), the origin reflects, and the measure is r^(d-1)dr. The same angular factor is omitted throughout; spherical analytic totals are M=512/375 and E=256/375. Its figure is a central section of a 1D radial solution, not a Cartesian 2D/3D calculation or a test of angular symmetry breaking.

algorithm.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
algorithm.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

validation.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
validation.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

limits.ja: 平面・円筒は空間一次、球はMUSCL型の制限線形再構築を使う教育用計算です。原点過熱と有限格子のplateau誤差が残り、全域誤差から原点を除外しません。r²重みで中心欠陥が小さく見えるため、原点を含む固定coreの誤差と拡大図も示します。L∞や中心最大誤差のゼロ収束、滑らかな球問題での方式全体の高次精度、幾何源付き全RK段階の一般の正値性保証、Cartesian多次元、任意γの独立照合は検証していません。円筒L∞は旧系列で単調減少せず、球のL2/L∞と過熱も診断値として保持します。球の離散質量・エネルギー収支が丸め誤差でも、解析総量との差は境界時間求積のO(dt²)となります。半径方向の運動量には幾何源があり、保存されるCartesian運動量とは異なります。ExactPackは解析評価器の独立実装で、別の数値PDEエンジンではありません。
limits.en: An educational calculation: first-order space in planar/cylindrical flow and MUSCL-type limited linear reconstruction in spherical flow. Origin heating and finite-grid plateau errors remain; the center is never removed from whole-domain error. Because r^2 weighting can make central defects appear small, an origin-inclusive fixed-core norm and enlarged view are also shown. Vanishing Linf/center maximum error, high order for the complete method on smooth spherical problems, general stage positivity with the geometric source, Cartesian multidimensional flow and independent arbitrary-gamma validation are not established. Cylindrical Linf was not monotone in the old series; spherical L2/Linf and heating are retained as diagnostics. Roundoff-scale discrete mass/energy balance coexists with O(dt^2) spherical boundary-time-quadrature error against analytic totals. Radial momentum has a geometric source and is not a conserved Cartesian momentum component. ExactPack independently implements the analytic evaluator, not another numerical PDE engine.

note.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
note.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.
